usage: deskops view [-h] {board,task,drawer,inbox,agents} ...

Read-only views of this desk for the deskops UI (contract: docs/deskops-
ui.md).

positional arguments:
  {board,task,drawer,inbox,agents}
    board               Board view: one column per lifecycle node with task
                        cards, gates, closeout evidence, pills and atoms.
    task                Task view: the board card plus the TaskDoc sections,
                        next actions and the advance revision.
    drawer              Drawer view: deferred tasks in desk/drawer/tasks with
                        excerpt and the add task --from-drawer command.
    inbox               Inbox view: notes in desk/inbox with sender, target,
                        date, ack state and body.
    agents              Agents view: live Herdr workers and the latest runs of
                        runs/subagents/index.jsonl.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
